actual_rule_observed: Under autogenerate, entries sort ascending by sidebar.order; a missing order key sorts last; an order tie breaks by slug/id (not title); sidebar.hidden:true removes the entry from the nav but the page still builds.
config_change: Appended { label: 'OrderProbes', items: [{ autogenerate: { directory: 'orderprobes' } }] } to the sidebar array; reverted afterwards.
notes: Supplementary run (not one of the six canonical probes) because the default starter uses an explicit sidebar array where sidebar.order frontmatter has no effect. Pages: o-low.md (order 1), o-mid-a.md (order 5, title 'Zulu Mid'), o-mid-b.md (order 5, title 'Alpha Mid'), o-high.md (order 9), o-none.md (no order), o-hidden.md (order 3, sidebar.hidden:true). Measured: (1) ascending order 1<5<9; (2) no-order page sorted AFTER all ordered pages; (3) tie at order 5 resolved by slug/id — 'Zulu Mid' (o-mid-a) preceded 'Alpha Mid' (o-mid-b) despite the title suggesting the reverse, so tie-break is NOT by title; (4) the sidebar.hidden:true page was absent from the nav but still built (dist/orderprobes/o-hidden/index.html existed), unlike under explicit config where the flag had no effect. Also observed: P1-extra — plain pages in an autogenerate directory appear automatically with no config change (cf. P5). Source-level corroboration (not docs): dist/utils/navigation.js getOrder() uses `sidebar.order ?? Number.MAX_VALUE` and sortDirEntries() tie-breaks with `sidebarCollator.compare(a.id, b.id)`; treeify() filters sidebar.hidden only in the autogenerate path. matched_documented_rule=false: official docs could not be loaded (browser service upstream 401), so these measured rules are undocumented-but-measured, not doc-verified.
